notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.
